senses.zh_definition: 【外语术语候选义，非已核实的马来语官方义项】芽胞；某些苔藓植物产生、能通过营养繁殖形成新植株的单细胞或多细胞繁殖体。
senses.en_definition: In botanical terminology, a small unicellular or multicellular vegetative propagule capable of developing into a new plant.
senses.ms_definition: Sebagai istilah botani asing, propagul vegetatif bersel tunggal atau berbilang sel yang dapat berkembang menjadi tumbuhan baharu; bukan takrif rasmi DBP yang telah disahkan.
senses.nuances: 澳大利亚国家植物园资料可核实此植物学义，但不能据此确认 gemma 已成为马来语官方词头，也无法确定输入词元是否实际指该术语。以下为术语讲解用的组合，未经马来语高频语料验证。[植物学说明](https://anbg.gov.au/bryophyte/vegetative-reproduction.html)

messages.en: It’s a small structure used for vegetative reproduction. It can grow into a new plant.

etymology.historical_story: The Australian National Botanic Gardens explains that gemma is the Latin word for jewel. In bryophyte terminology, it names a small reproductive structure; some liverworts carry these structures in tiny cups. The jewel connection offers a memorable image, although this botanical history does not establish official Malay adoption of the spelling gemma. [Botanical source](https://anbg.gov.au/bryophyte/reproduction-dispersal.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 借英语 gem“宝石”作提示：gemma 像一颗微小的绿色宝石，落在适宜环境里能长成新植株。
